name: Havas
verdict: Havas is Havas N.V., listed on Euronext Amsterdam and majority-controlled by Vincent Bolloré (53.05% of capital, 53.55% of voting rights; AFM register, February 2026). Nothing found.
note: Communications group; Alpine Endurance Team partner for 2026 (club release 19/03/2026). Vincent Bolloré's majority is held indirectly through Bolloré SE, Compagnie de l'Odet, Compagnie de l'Etoile des Mers and YB6 (claim havas-nv-bollore-control); the Bolloré family is private and no state link arises. The AFM register also records France's Caisse des Dépôts et Consignations at 3.00% via CDC Croissance (July 2025): below the 5% threshold, and France doesn't count as a state with a record under METHOD.md (maintainers' decision, September 2026).
